items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: There a fella called Dave Franklin used to work in Warline you see?

ctx.x: He could read huh? Sure he could read. Sure. Yeah.

Sam didn't whip nobody to. Sam go to the world iron group and buy his music man. Play. Well you know something like Buggalos. You see huh? Every new number used to come out. There a fella called Dave Franklin used to work in Warline you see? Mmhmm. And Dave Franklin used to, when you go over there, he'd give the fellas all the stations. He'd give you all the stations. And you'd get, every new number come out, we'd have it. Mmhmm. He wouldn't charge them a set? No. He'd give it. See they had some of the copies,…
Well I guess they gave him the leading officers and then the people would buy them for the piano and stuff. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
